description: Defines an interface for building responses and events related to modifying feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building command responses and events for modify feature definition commands.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses, including success and error responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by modify feature definition commands.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a 'created' response for a feature definition.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a 'modified' response for a feature definition.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition is not accessible.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition is not modifiable.
